claim_boundary: Versioned correction of L_POLY_A only. It proves no fourth moment, local multiplicity theorem, CGL theorem, density estimate, or short-interval result.

corrected_input.detector_effect: The qT tail repair may take A=3/2. Gamma decay remains the only tail-decay mechanism; no q<=T^C condition is introduced.
corrected_input.imprimitive_transfer: If chi is induced by chi* of conductor d|q, its finite Euler quotient has critical-line modulus at most product_{p|q,p not|d}(1+p^(-1/2)) <= 2^omega(q) <= q. Thus |L| << q[d(3+|v|)]^(1/2) <= [q(2+|v|)]^(3/2) up to an absolute constant.
corrected_input.primitive_specialization: Set K=Q, n_K=D_K=1, eta=1/2, sigma=1/2 in Thorner--Zaman Lemma Rademacher. For primitive conductor d, this gives |L(1/2+iv,chi*)| << [d(3+|v|)]^(1/2); the trivial-character ratio is at most 3 on the critical line.
corrected_input.statement: For every Dirichlet character chi modulo q and every real v, |L(1/2+iv,chi)| << [q(2+|v|)]^(3/2), with an absolute implied constant.

source.locator: Lemma Rademacher, TeX 642--651; completed conductor definition TeX 565--585
